pages.title: Aleph-Null Shard
pages.text: Aleph-null is the size of the set of natural numbers, the smallest infinity. This shard makes it solid: a crystal whose facets can be counted one by one but never finished. It is cool and clear, and every time I count its edges I lose track at a larger number.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found one in a Hilbert Hotel, where every room was full and still had space. To make more, the Cantor Diagonalizer paired a Natural Number Lattice with its Power Set and a Superintelligence Core counted them.
